name: Bloodied Insignia
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database. Its experience counts the level 30 build, which halved what dungeon quests give beyond a normal quest.

narrative.details: <The old Alliance insignia appears to have belonged to a soldier of Lordaeron. These ruins are likely filled with similar medals that living relatives would be grateful to have returned to them.>
narrative.objectives: Collect 10 Bloodied Insignias and take them to General Marcus Jonathan in Stormwind City.
narrative.offerRewardText: Your instincts to bring these to me were not unfounded. When Lordaeron fell to the scourge, many people fled to take refuge here in Stormwind. There are likely few who remain to claim these insignias themselves.Your duty to Stormwind is commended, Black. I'll begin distributing these tokens to next of kin right away.
narrative.requestItemsText: You look as if you're carrying a heavy burden, Black. What is it?
